name: Universal Pantograph

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. Reference-only powers are described in text and have no action button.

summary: Reference-only: closing this 2-foot box around a nonmagical item creates a duplicate beside it.
text: Reference-only: closing this 2-foot box around a nonmagical item creates a duplicate beside it. Magic actions enlarge it for a Medium creature or restore its size. Enclose a creature and consume 100 GP diamond dust to cast Clone; after casting the creature exits and the box locks for 120 days. The completed clone needs no vessel. Without a clone inside, 999 years submerged in a Feywild bog destroys it.
